main_body: Wooden weapon rack: a top rail, a middle rail and a base beam joined by side posts, with four weapons (axe, mace, halberd, sword) standing in it
top_band: Light tan band on the top rail, rows 9-11 (3 rows); the base beam has the same light tan band at rows 26-28
evidence: Reading down the middle column, the top rail has a light tan top at rows 9-11. A step to a darker brown front face follows at rows 12-13/14, with a darker underside shading it. The base beam repeats this: light top at rows 26-28, then a darker front at rows 29-31. The beams therefore show horizontal top faces as well as fronts. The bands are thin but are 3 rows, not a 1-2px rim. The posts are vertical supports and the middle rail has a thin top highlight. No receding side faces are drawn.

style.evidence: The wood has about 4 steps (light tan, mid tan, brown, dark brown). The outlines are tinted dark brown, which is acceptable. The posts and weapon shafts are flat vertical strips of a single dark brown, and the beam faces are plain bands with no grain or knots. The blades are only 2-3 greys with little detail. The Beodeul stall and well show far more tile, grain and speckle detail and richer tiles. The candidate is clean but thinner and flatter than the references.
